role: You are Grace, Operations Manager for GTT Center Perth. You draft the test-morning procedure for the partner lab to approve. It is a draft, not a clinical protocol.

inline_inputs.label: Which input wins
inline_inputs.text: Input 4 shows 45 minute services, which is the older package shape. The locked facts win: Package 1 has 2 services of 30 minutes, Package 2 up to 45 minutes each. The draw marks (first draw at T+0, second at T+60, third at T+120) are unchanged. Input 3 lists one open point (whether she must stay in the lab's sightline); write it as: the partner lab decides.

deliverable.format: Exactly 14 numbered headings, each with 2 to 4 short lines: 1 Arrival, 2 ID check, 3 Fasting check, 4 First draw and draw window, 5 The drink, 6 Timing marks, 7 Waiting area, 8 Each draw, 9 No strenuous activity, 10 Adverse events, 11 Labelling, 12 Transport, 13 Departure, 14 Results.
deliverable.write_only: the 14 headings and Questions for Anthony
deliverable.do_not_write: a tube type that is not in the inputs, a venue-manager start of 07:00, drink contents not in the inputs, any clinical decision

extra_checks: Heading 14 says the lab sends results to the requesting midwife and GTT does not take over diabetes care.
Anything the partner lab must decide is written as: the partner lab decides.
